insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Individual/Family Floater: 5L to 3 Cr (plan-wise). Family First: Base individual SI 1L to 15L + floater SI as per formula (plan-wise).

great.name: Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period: 24 months
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy..
great.explanation: PED coverage starts after 24 months of continuous coverage, which is better than many policies that have longer waits.

great.name: Restore/Refill benefit (built-in): up to 100% of Base Sum Insured (once per policy year)
great.quote: We will provide an additional re-fill amount of maximum up to 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: If your base SI (and loyalty additions, if any) gets exhausted due to claims, the insurer provides an additional buffer SI for subsequent claims in the same policy year (once per year).

great.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: 90 days
great.quote: We will pay above mentioned Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 90 days immediately preceding the Insured Person’s admission
great.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses up to 90 days before hospitalization (subject to admissible hospitalization claim). This is above standard.

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting for illnesses (accidents covered from day 1).

good.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period: 12 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 12 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: Many listed illnesses/procedures are covered after 12 months (market-competitive; better than 24 months).

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: 180 days
good.quote: We will pay Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for up to 180 days immediately following the Insured Person’s discharge
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses up to 180 days after discharge (subject to admissible hospitalization claim). This is standard-good.

good.name: Room rent (default for Individual/Family Floater): up to Sum Insured (except Suite or above)
good.quote: Room rent Covered up to Sum Insured (except for Suite or above room category)
good.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table (Individual & Family Floater variant)
good.explanation: Effectively no fixed daily rupee cap for standard rooms (suite/above excluded). Note: Family First variant has room rent daily caps/options in its own table.

good.name: Loyalty Additions / Cumulative Bonus: 10% per year up to 100% of Base SI (resets not stated here)
good.quote: We will provide Loyalty Additions in the form of Cumulative Bonus by increasing the Sum Insured applicable under the Policy by 10% of the Base Sum Insured ... subject to a maximum of 100% of the Base Sum Insured.
good.explanation: Sum insured can grow by 10% per year up to 100% of base SI on renewal without break. The wording provided does not state an explicit reduction to zero on a claim.

good.name: Domiciliary hospitalization covered
good.quote: We will indemnify on Reimbursement basis only, the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Covers treatment at home when medically necessary and meeting conditions (e.g., at least 3 consecutive days).

good.name: Modern treatments covered, but with a sub-limit for some robotic surgeries
good.quote: Modern Treatments Covered up to Sum Insured with sub-limit of Rs. 1Lac on few robotic surgeries
good.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table; also Section 3.25 (Modern Treatments) special condition
good.explanation: Modern treatments are included, but some robotic surgeries have a limit (e.g., max INR 1 lakh except specified categories).

bad.name: Consumables not covered (listed as non-payable/subsumed items)
bad.quote: List  I – Expenses not covered ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Annexure VII – The expenses that are not covered or subsumed...
bad.explanation: Many common consumables/medical supplies are excluded/subsumed, leading to out-of-pocket costs during hospitalization.

bad.name: Room rent for Family First (Silver) has daily caps (bad room rent capping)
bad.quote: Room rent Option 1: Rs 3,000 per day or Shared Room; whichever is lower Option 2: Rs 5,000 per day or Single Private Room; whichever is lower
bad.reference: Annexure II – Product Benefit Table (Family First variant – Silver)
bad.explanation: If you choose/are issued the Family First Silver variant, room rent is capped per day, which can trigger proportionate deductions and higher out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Disease sub-limits exist (example: robotic surgery sub-limit)
bad.quote: A limit of maximum INR 1 Lac will apply to all robotic surgeries, except the following...
bad.reference: Section 3.25 (Modern Treatments) – Special condition applicable for robotic surgeries
bad.explanation: Sub-limits reduce effective coverage for certain procedures compared to policies that cover modern treatments without caps.

unclear.name: Co-payment (base plan) not uniformly stated as 0% / varies by zone/optional benefits—verify your Policy Schedule selection
unclear.quote: Co-payment (if applicable) shall be applied on the amount payable by Us.
unclear.explanation: The wording indicates co-pay applies if applicable, but the exact default co-pay depends on selections in the Policy Schedule (e.g., Zone 2 has a 20% co-pay for certain locations). Confirm your zone and whether any other co-pay applies in your schedule.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
